r5_completion.north_tiein: The two vertices and full north-facing wall on segment 0 retain revision 05 model coordinates. North stair/MU alignment and R1 entries are deferred. All other R5 vertices use this sheet registration. Upper east/west wall X lines continue the fixed north endpoints; their source residuals are reported.
limits: R5 XY follows a manual orthogonal enclosure trace and per-sheet dimensioned-grid calibration. This establishes source-governed provisional placement, not verified as-built dimensions.
The north wall and stair/MU alignment retain revision 05 geometry and the 42.443-pixel diagnostic maximum. R1 north entries are also deferred.
South MO/MJ outer jambs and contiguous interface replace the former MO/MU transcription and unsupported masonry gap. Complete internal frame profiles remain assumed without the schedule.

R5 sill/head dimensions, wall and slab thicknesses, parapet/coping sections and guards remain assumed or provisional. A2.08 is an independent diagnostic comparison, not a second authority for floor-plan wall positions.
Differences between plan and elevation projections are reported as residuals. No common dimensional accuracy tolerance or source agreement certificate is asserted.
r5_completion.disposition: R5 enclosure topology and south/east/west jambs provisionally reconciled; north work deferred and source discrepancies retained.

p1.basis: Separate orthogonal enclosure traced from A2.02, including north retaining-wall steps, the east garage/service recess and residential south steps. Open north ventilation shaft and external planters/trellises are excluded from enclosed floor area. Centerlines, wall thickness, floor flatness and below-grade wall heights remain simplified; the 337-to-342 parking ramp is not modeled.

r5.basis: Move the southeast inner corner to the A2.07 wall centerline; retain the adjoining long east wall and south baseline as inherited tie-ins. Rebuild the return, adjoining east/south walls, R5 slab, south roof plate and four adjoining coping pieces together. A2.08 independently shows the same local return topology; its roof step is a check, not a second wall-position authority.
